from collections import Counter
def f(inp):
    inp=[row[:] for row in inp]; out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r in range(h):

        if not cols: continue
        mx=max(cols)
        for c in range(mx+1,w):
            out[r][c]=1
    return out
